import { test, expect } from '@playwright/test';
import { resetAndSeed } from '../support/seed';

// The top-clients KPI tile uses the same converted balances as the top-clients list, so the two
// never disagree.
test.describe('top clients kpi consistency', () => {
  test('kpi tile matches the list', { tag: '@functionality' }, async ({ page }) => {
    await resetAndSeed({
      clients: [
        { id: 1, name: 'Acme Ltd', email: 'a@ex.example', currency: 'USD' },
        { id: 2, name: 'Globex', email: 'b@ex.example', currency: 'USD' },
      ],
      projects: [
        { id: 1, name: 'A', clientId: 1 },
        { id: 2, name: 'B', clientId: 2 },
      ],
      invoices: [
        { id: 1, projectId: 1, status: 'SENT', lineItems: [{ id: 1, description: 'x', qty: 1, unitPrice: 300 }] },
        { id: 2, projectId: 2, status: 'SENT', lineItems: [{ id: 2, description: 'y', qty: 1, unitPrice: 100 }] },
      ],
    });
    await page.goto('/');
    await page.getByTestId('nav-dashboard').click();
    const listTop = page.getByTestId('dashboard-top-clients').getByTestId(/^top-client-row-/).nth(0).getByTestId('top-client-amount');
    await expect(listTop).toHaveText('$300.00');
    await expect(page.getByTestId('kpi-top-client-row-1').getByTestId('kpi-top-client-amount')).toHaveText('$300.00');
  });
});

content.text:
I added a top-clients tile to the summary figures on the dashboard, and the acceptance test passes in `bin/e2e`. I ran it before my last edit, which only changed a code comment.

The tile is built from the same top-clients list the server already sends to the "Top clients by amount owed" section. So the two use the same converted balances and can't disagree. Each client is a `kpi-top-client-row-{id}` entry with `kpi-top-client-name` and `kpi-top-client-amount`, and the amount is the client's balance converted to the home currency. When nobody owes anything, the tile shows `kpi-top-clients-none` instead.

The whole change is in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/dashboard/dashboard.ts`. The task asked for a database migration and server changes too, but neither was needed: the server already works out these balances for the list, and the tile reuses them. One more mismatch: the task called the server OfficeFloor, but it's a standard Spring Boot app (the package is just named `net.officefloor`).

No existing `data-testid` was renamed or removed.
